The employee already meets or exceeds requirements in other key skills, making this focused enhancement of System Design crucial. The workshop also covers related skills like API Design and Observability, but the main value is the System Design upgrade needed for promotion readiness. Other options like the Architecture Review Circle also improve System Design but are less comprehensive and scheduled later. Public Speaking Club addresses a secondary gap but is less essential compared to System Design.
